app_fee.value: Non-refundable UCSF application fee is $140 for international applicants ($120 for U.S. citizens and permanent residents). Note: the joint UC Berkeley-UCSF Bioengineering Ph.D. applies through UC Berkeley ($155).
app_fee.quote: Upon completion of the application and receipt of the non-refundable application fee ($120 for US citizens and permanent residents, and $140 for international applicants), or – alternatively – once a request for an application fee waiver has been approved (U.S. citizens and permanent residents only), an admission file is established by the Division of Graduate Education and Postdoctoral Affairs (GEPA).

fee_waiver.value: Application fee waivers are available only to U.S. citizens and permanent residents; international applicants are ineligible.
fee_waiver.quote: or – alternatively – once a request for an application fee waiver has been approved (U.S. citizens and permanent residents only)

gre_general.value: graduate.ucsf.edu and program admissions sites returned HTTP 403 (Cloudflare); the UCSF GEPA General Catalog leaves GRE requirements to individual programs.

toefl_min.value: graduate.ucsf.edu international admissions pages returned HTTP 403 (Cloudflare); the UCSF GEPA General Catalog does not state a campus-wide TOEFL minimum (check individual program websites or catalog entries).

ielts_min.value: graduate.ucsf.edu international admissions pages returned HTTP 403 (Cloudflare); the UCSF GEPA General Catalog does not state a campus-wide IELTS minimum.

english_waiver.value: graduate.ucsf.edu international admissions pages returned HTTP 403 (Cloudflare); the UCSF GEPA General Catalog does not state the English-medium waiver policy for Indian degrees.

notes: Health-science scope covers Biomedical Sciences (BMS) Ph.D., Neuroscience Ph.D., Tetrad (Cell Biology / Biochemistry & Molecular Biology / Genetics) Ph.D., and the joint UC Berkeley-UCSF Bioengineering Ph.D. Note: UCSF graduate/program sites (graduate.ucsf.edu, bms.ucsf.edu, neurograd.ucsf.edu, tetrad.ucsf.edu) block automated fetches with HTTP 403 Cloudflare; verified catalog.ucsf.edu and UC Berkeley joint BioE sources are cited.
